## About
We're redefining the image of the handyman. You know the drill: you call a contractor, nobody calls back, or the work isn't what you hoped for. We want to be the first number you think of instead.
Whether you need to hang pictures, change a faucet, hang a TV, or you want to do a full remodel, we handle electrical, plumbing and carpentry work for homes and businesses. We also check on your house when you're away.
You'll find us at 7933 E Cactus Rd in Scottsdale. Our neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 57 Google reviews.

## Services
- Electrical: Small electrical repairs or large ones. One customer had us swap old fluorescent fixtures for new LED fixtures.
- Plumbing: From a leaking faucet to a new water heater, we get leaks handled.
- Carpentry: Carpentry and drywall work alongside our electrical and plumbing jobs.
- Home Watch: Professional, thorough home watch for whenever you and your family are not home.
- Full remodel: Everything you need to remodel or redo your home or business.
- Hang pictures, change a faucet, hang a TV: The small jobs on your list are worth a call too.

## FAQ
Q: How do I schedule service?
A: Call us at 602.904.1701 or email Floyd@FixItFloyd.com.

Q: How soon will I hear back?
A: You'll hear back from us within 24 hours or the next business day.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can you check on my house while we're out of town?
A: Yes. Our home watch service checks on your house while you're away for an extended period.

Q: Can I text you?
A: Yes, if you opt in. We use texts to answer questions about our services and pricing and to confirm appointments. Text STOP anytime to opt out.
